title: Bar Juice 5000 Grape Blueberry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Grape Blueberry Ice from Bar Juice 5000 blends two bold fruit notes for a smooth, chilled vape. Dark Grape delivers its signature deep sweetness, while ripe Blueberry adds a soft, jammy layer for extra richness. The combination is lifted by an icy finish, bringing brightness and freshness to each exhale. Crafted with nicotine salts, this mix offers fast-acting satisfaction with a smooth, comfortable throat feel, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits including pod systems and pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it suits a wide range of users. Produced in the UK and blended at 50PG/50VG, Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts are made for high-impact flavour with subtle vapour, capturing the sweet-chilled profiles this range is known for. Works perfectly in refillable pod vape kit and vape starter kits .
